venueInfo.directions: Raju Gari Gardens Kalyana Mandapam is in Seethanagaram, Andhra Pradesh — easily reachable from nearby towns and major roads.
venueInfo.parking: Ample parking is available within the mandapam premises for all invited guests.
venueInfo.accommodation: Guests travelling from afar may find comfortable stays nearby in Seethanagaram and surrounding towns. Please contact either family for assistance with arrangements.
venueInfo.travel: Visakhapatnam Airport is the closest major airport. Local trains and road routes connect comfortably to Seethanagaram.

receptionVenueInfo.directions: Subhamasthu Function Hall is beside NH 16 at Neeladriraopeta, Andhra Pradesh — convenient access from the highway.
receptionVenueInfo.parking: Parking is available at the function hall for reception guests.
receptionVenueInfo.travel: Located beside NH 16 for easy road access from nearby towns and cities.
